name: Low-Carb Unstuffed Cabbage Beef Skillet

fit_check.note: 474 cal / 11g carb clears the 400-650 cal, <=35g carb, no-seafood, scalable band; rejected as a duplicate, NOT on fit.

reason: Same dish as catalog unstuffed-cabbage-roll-bowls: deconstructed cabbage rolls of ground beef + green cabbage + tomato + onion/pepper in one skillet. Identical cabbage-roll identity, same protein, same tomato flavor family; the only differences are dropping the rice for low-carb and adding cheddar-jack - formulation tweaks, not a different dinner.
pool_dupe: Also a pool near-duplicate of sibling candidate beef-unstuffed-cabbage-skillet (already ruled DUPE of the same catalog recipe) - essentially the same low-carb ground-beef + cabbage + tomato + cheddar-jack skillet from a different source. Keep at most one; both should fall to the catalog dupe. NOT a dupe of the pool's mediterranean-beef-cabbage-skillet (that one is a no-tomato, no-cheese Middle Eastern baharat/cumin skillet - only 2-of-4 overlap).
cross_protein_collision: Unstuffed cabbage roll is protein-swappable and already clusters across proteins (catalog turkey-cabbage-roll-soup). Any turkey or pork unstuffed-cabbage / cabbage-roll skillet in another pool is the structurally same dinner - flag for the cross-protein merge.
